from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    # Extend each left-aligned horizontal bar with the contrasting marker color.\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        n = 0\n        while n < len(row) and row[n] != bg:\n            n += 1\n        if 0 < n < len(row) and all(v == bg for v in row[n:]):\n            row[n:] = [1] * (len(row) - n)\n    return out\n'''
p=base/'task-152098bf.py'; p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),ns)
demo=[[2]*23 for _ in range(20)]; demo[6]=[6]*23; demo[14]=[6]*16+[2]*7
o=ns['transform'](demo)
expected=[r[:] for r in demo]; expected[14]=[6]*16+[1]*7
print('demo match',o==expected)
test=[[0]*9 for _ in range(29)]; test[2]=[4]*9; test[15]=[4]*5+[0]*4; test[23]=[4]*4+[0]*5
result=ns['transform'](test)
print(result[2],result[15],result[23])
